note: Functions of /bin/sld between 0x71ca and 0x8682 that are libc objects (putchar, scanf, doscan identical to slibc.a; printf, doprnt another revision), reconstructed as C earlier (2026-10-27/28) and then taken out of sld.c (git history has the sources). The audit data is kept here.

f7bbc.pairing_evidence: frame 14 bytes against 8 here; arguments and the swap of two words are reloaded from the frame in the original (D4); semantics equal

f85f8.pairing_evidence: register allocation differs (counter r11, value r10, pointer rr12 in the original; the character is also kept in the frame). Semantics equal, including the count quirk: with a sign the loop counts the original n, the return uses the decremented n (see KNOWLEDGE quirks)

audit.difference_note: indirect byte store through another register pair (rr2 here, rr4 in the original)
addressing of the count and pointer fields through register pairs and constant index (indirect and indexed forms, D5); by reading, no popt pattern

ld_doprnt.pairing_evidence: 714 instructions, same count as the original; 60 differ in content (order-independent comparison): register choice of temporaries (D2) and block placement / jump lengths (D7); frame 144 and stack offsets equal (fncheck strict); stream writes use the putc macro form; semantics checked by reading only, not run

audit.difference_note: unexplained instruction forms: dec	@rrS,#1; ld	rS,#N; ld	rS,@rrS; multl	rqS,#N

ld_doscan.pairing_evidence: 175 instructions equal in count and order; only the temporaries differ: the old compiler keeps r2 reserved inside the switch body (ours: pointer copy in rr4 and byte in r3, original rr2 and r4); the form with the case bodies outside the switch has the original registers but puts the jump table stub after the compare (layout); semantics checked by reading only

ld_scanf.pairing_evidence: dead code (no caller, no address reference): wrapper of 0x7300 with a constant format; the address forms of the local pair and of the fourth argument differ (D5/D16). Same 14 instructions; the order of the format load differs (D15)

ld_fscanf.pairing_evidence: dead code (no caller, no address reference): wrapper of 0x7300 that copies the third and fourth argument into a local pair; the stack address of the fifth argument is formed through rr0 in the original (D5/D16, address forms). Same 13 instructions

ld_sscanf.pairing_evidence: wrapper of the formatter 0x7300 (5 callers): the old cc spills all four argument registers and the parameter in rr6 (D4), the byte local is placed one byte later in the frame (D16). Same 30 instructions; the formatter 0x7300 is still a deferred function (declared as a call)

ld_doprnt.note: putc macro form (--cnt < 0 ? _flsbuf : (int)(*ptr++ = c)) reproduces the stream writes; 714 instructions equal in count, 60 differ in content: register choice of temporaries (rr4/r3 where ours uses rr2/r4, D2) and block placement of the output block and jump lengths (jr/jp, D7); frame 144 and stack offsets equal; semantics checked by reading only
